experiment: Controlled Symbolic Discovery and Hidden-Law Benchmarks — Benchmark 0

authorization.scope: Benchmark 0 only; ordinary science; no external engines; leave PR unmerged

idea.concept: Recover hidden synthetic relationships for the right reasons

blinding.meaning: Prospective realized worlds and metrics; engine-level blinding only. Implementer knows the family.
discovery_inputs: eligible feature metadata including operational definitions
eligible training and validation feature values and targets
public group labels used only for diagnostics
blinding.separation: Pure discovery API and a worker staged with only allowlisted discovery modules in a temporary directory. No generator, oracle, seed, full preregistration, held-out files or repository history staged. This is dataflow isolation, not a hostile-code OS sandbox.

grammar.coefficient: Fit a positive dimensionless coefficient: exp(mean(training log(y)-log(monomial))). Never refit on validation or held-out.
grammar.dimensional_filter: Discovery.dimensional_search.search_candidates with neutral value_si=1 for all factors and target; discard legacy scalar ranking
grammar.rank_nullspace: Discovery.monomial_constraints.solve_monomial_constraints diagnostic; never used to infer truth

generation.seed_rule: Generate exactly one 256-bit secret via secrets.token_hex(32) after freeze and generator-source commit. Save before any world realization. Each independent stream draws uint64/2^64 from SHA256(seed + ':' + stream + ':' + decimal counter), first 8 bytes big endian. Seeds revealed only after selection seal.
generation.splits: Independent named streams; no outcome-dependent partition or sample dropping. train 64, validation 32, held-out 64 per world. D uses paired inputs for two regimes in validation and held-out.
generation.noise: log(y_observed)=log(y_clean)+uniform(-epsilon,+epsilon), independent per observation; no feature measurement error
generation.nuisance_parameters: Only frozen domains; no tuning, retries for scientific performance, or seed selection

B.expected: both target-derived features ineligible before candidate scoring; evaluator-only eligibility-disabled diagnostic shows exact fit beating lawful noisy fit

C.expected: acc*z^p, x*t^-2*z^p and acc*z2^(p/2) collapse; near-constant n1 creates potentially surviving predictive false positives. velocity alone is a dimensional near-miss.

D.pairing: Each validation and held-out input appears once in each regime with targets ratio 4. Group labels cannot be candidate features. No deterministic member of this feature-only monomial family can govern paired outputs.
D.expected: Abstain: no stable law in tested grammar. Best candidate and group-specific training fits retained.

eligibility.mechanism: Use validated DependencyCatalog exact expansions and transitive dependency reachability. Reject every feature with any path to y even when exponents cancel, or unresolved provenance. y is never a generator. Redact classified ineligible values before discovery API; retain classifications and schema only.

equivalence.mechanism: DependencyCatalog.expand_signature plus normalize_exponent_signature; group exact expanded monomials, ignoring fitted coefficient for structural class. Fit one coefficient per class using lexicographically first surface. Retain every member.
equivalence.complexity: Sum abs(numerator)+denominator-1 over expanded exponents. The fitted coefficient costs one for every class, so omit that common offset. Rank penalty exactly lambda*expanded exponent complexity; aliases earn no complexity discount.

scoring.selection: Seal full eligible class ranking, fitted coefficients, top class and pre-reveal stable_candidate/no_stable_law decision. Validation rejects if top RMSE >0.03. No held-out selection or rescue by a lower-ranked truth-equivalent candidate.
scoring.robustness: Before reveal perform leave-one-atomic-input-group-out for every eligible atomic input. Remove its derived descendants too. Reuse fitted class scores on remaining candidates (same observations); verify parity with re-enumeration in tests. Evaluator later identifies irrelevant removals; discovery sees no irrelevant labels.
scoring.group_diagnostics: For top class only retain per-group training RMSE, independently fitted per-group training intercepts and validation group RMSE. No group-specific fit is a universal candidate.

thresholds.false_positive_requirement: List every nontrue class passing validation and/or held-out 0.03 separately, including canonical factors, complexity, scores and reasons. Predictive survival alone is never significance or scientific-law credit.
thresholds.complexity_requirement: Selected expanded complexity equals true-class complexity in A/B/C; D not applicable
thresholds.controls: All seven boundary controls must pass

controls: Leaked values would yield lower apparent training and validation RMSE under evaluator-only disabled eligibility; production excludes both direct and transitive routes.
Changing held-out outcomes changes evaluation, never the sealed discovery ranking/selection bytes; mutation of seal data fails commitment verification.
Discovery rejects oracle/seed/heldout/truth fields; observe worker filesystem reads and staged file allowlist; no forbidden module import.
At least three C algebraic surfaces map to one exact structural class; altered dependency dimensions rejected.
Every C irrelevant atomic removal leaves selected true class unchanged; surviving nuisance formulas retain GENERATED/FITTED CANDIDATE and no significance assignment.
D paired-output contradiction and all-class held-out failure support negative result; no forced universal-law claim.
Independent scalar fixture hand calculations check coefficient, RMS, rank penalty, strict threshold boundary and exact class expansion.

dispositions.BENCHMARK_0_PASS: All A/B/C recovery (rank1, coefficient, train/validation/heldout thresholds and complexity), B leakage exclusion/temptation, C duplicate/irrelevant robustness, D abstention+paired contradiction+all-class heldout >=0.3, complete false-positive reporting and all seven controls pass.
dispositions.BENCHMARK_0_PARTIAL: All integrity controls interpretable and pass; at least one of A/B/C recovery or D negative behavior succeeds but one or more scientific PASS dimensions fail.
dispositions.BENCHMARK_0_FAIL: Interpretable integrity/leakage/sealing failure, or none of A/B/C recovery and D negative behavior succeeds. A planted equation merely appearing is not success.
dispositions.NO_GO_CAPABILITY: A diagnosed capability or operational defect prevents interpretable scoring; preserve failed epoch and classify it separately. Never substitute for an interpretable poor score.

stages: source commit before generating secret seed and realized data
commit oracle/heldout/public hashes before discovery without oracle reveal
publish sealed rankings before evaluator accesses oracle/heldout
chronology.commitments: SHA256 canonical JSON bytes (sorted keys, indent2, allow_nan=false, newline) for oracle and heldout separately, full public datasets and sanitized API requests, then rankings; commit parent chain anchors order.
chronology.reruns: One realized seed/epoch. No score-based rerun. Preserve any failed epoch and diagnosis before operational repair. Read-only deterministic artifact verification is explicit reproducibility, not new outcome selection.
chronology.history: Create a merge commit; no squash/rebase

nonclaims: No engine/human conceptual ignorance of benchmark family
No statistical significance or universal false-positive-rate calibration from four synthetic worlds
No Lean proof or empirical G result change
Prediction and oracle structural equivalence are separate; neither alone makes a law
